title: European Data Format toolbox
summary: Read and write EDF, EDF+, BDF and BDF+ biosignal files.
description: A toolbox that owns the EDF, EDF+, BDF and BDF+ binary format and returns a domain-free struct. Read and write signals and annotations, inspect headers, window and resample, decode BDF triggers, edit, crop, merge, anonymize, validate and convert units. Designed to be a dependency of higher-level toolboxes such as ecglab and sleeplab.
